text:
raj: Heads-up — nightly h100 suite turned red after my rebase. Failing: tests/inference/h100_warmup_test.py::test_warmup with OOM + kernel Xid messages. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/ci/48392

ci-bot: [CI] job 48392 failed — test h100_warmup_test.py::test_warmup (x1) — logs: https://artifacts.ci/48392/logs.txt | image: gcr.io/redwood-ci/h100-nightly:2026-04-04-abc123

emma: did we bump drivers or cuda in the base image recently? quick diff of the image shows host driver 535.101 vs container runtime expecting 530.x — could be a host/container mismatch.

mike: re-ran the job manually once (job 48392-rerun-0) — still flaky. snippet from kernel log: 
```
kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00:00): 79, PID=12345: GPU has fallen off the bus
kernel: nv_peer_memory: enqueuing timeout
```
Full job stdout: https://artifacts.ci/48392/attempt0/full.log

sara: can someone bisect? this smells like either a driver/tooling change or an intermittent mem-fragmentation after the rebase. if it's driver mismatch we should pin the driver in CI images ASAP. Suggested bisect command: `git bisect start --bad HEAD --good v2026-03-30; git bisect run ./scripts/ci/h100-smoke.sh`

raj: I can do a local repro on a single h100 node, but I need the exact image + job id. @ci-bot where are the artifacts and docker digest?

ci-bot: Artifact metadata for job 48392: imageDigest: sha256:0f4e2a...; artifact: gs://redwood-ci/48392/artifacts.tgz; test command: `python -m pytest tests/inference/h100_warmup_test.py::test_warmup -k warmup --maxfail=1`

emma: small repro tips: try `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0` and set `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` to get deterministic stack traces. also try running with `--warmup-seed=1` and `--disable-kv-cache` to rule out prefix cache interactions.

mike: starting bisect now on the nightly branch. command: `git bisect start --bad HEAD --good v2026-03-30; git bisect run ./scripts/ci/h100-smoke.sh` — will post updates here. If it hits a flaky commit I'll rerun locally with the imageDigest.

raj: if bisect points at a tooling/packaging change, we should open an infra ticket to pin the host driver and add a CI guard. cc: @infra

sara: short-term mitigation: pls rerun the failing job on a dedicated h100 node (no shared preemptible). @ci-bot please schedule rerun with node selector `h100-dedicated-01` and attach `LD_DEBUG=files` env to capture loader issues.

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: job 48392-rerun-1 started on h100-dedicated-01 (eta ~12m). env: {CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1, LD_DEBUG=files}. artifact will be posted when finished. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

emma: perfect — if rerun still fails, include `LD_PRELOAD=/opt/redwood/diagnostics/libnvidia_debug.so` and `dmesg -T | tail -n50` in the artifacts. also collect `nvidia-smi -q` output.

mike: ack — monitoring rerun. will paste logs here when available.
